title: David Zwirner Exits New York’s Upper East Side
summary: David Zwirner has closed its outpost at 34 East Sixty-Ninth Street in New York, Artnet News reports. The gallery had occupied space in a town house there since 2017. title: New Bill Aims to Protect Publicly Commissioned Art in Federal Buildings
summary: A new bill, introduced on July 14th by Congressional Arts Caucus members Dina Titus (D-Nevada) and Lloyd Doggett (D-Texas), is proposing the establishment of a procedure that would secure publicly commissioned art in federal buildings. title: From the Archive: Eva Hesse in Conversation
summary: Only weeks before Eva Hesse’s passing in May 1970, Artforum published an interview between the pioneering post-Minimalist artist and critic Cindy Nemser.
